text.p: Tupperware Corp said on Thursday E.V. (Rick) Goings, 51, was elected chairman and chief executive officer, to replace Warren Batts upon his retirement at the end of September.
"I am confident that Rick will provide the kind of leadership that will propel Tupperware to strong growth in the future," Batts said in a statement.
Tupperware is a direct seller and major supplier of food storage containers.
Goings would become chairman effective October 1, after Batts retired September 30, the company said.
Goings joined Tupperware in 1992 as president. Before that, he held several top management positions with Avon Products Inc, Tupperware said.
Tupperware also said in a separate statement Jose Timmerman was elected senior vice president, worldwide operations. He was vice president of this division.
